evidence.content: ADR-001: Beacon will use Kafka as the message broker for all event ingestion.
ADR-002: Beacon will use JSON for event serialization.
ADR-003: Beacon will use a single Kafka partition for all events.
ADR-004: The main ingestion module is named 'ingest-core'.
CON-001: All PII must be hashed before ingestion into Beacon.
ADR-005: Beacon will add a schema registry requirement for all event types.
ADR-006: Beacon will use Protobuf for event serialization (supersedes ADR-002).
ADR-007: Beacon will use a single Kafka partition with batching for simplicity.
Beacon monitoring uses Prometheus with Grafana dashboards.
Beacon deployment uses Docker containers orchestrated by Kubernetes.
ADR-008: Beacon rejects the proposal to switch back to JSON for debugging.
ADR-009: Beacon will use multiple Kafka partitions (supersedes ADR-003, ADR-007).
Beacon testing strategy includes unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests.
ADR-010: Beacon will add a new data source with email addresses.
ADR-011: The main ingestion module is renamed to 'event-gateway' (supersedes ADR-004).
Beacon performance target is 100,000 events per second.
Beacon reliability target is 99.9% uptime.
Beacon benchmark at t3: 85,000 events per second sustained throughput.
ADR-012: Beacon will use a single partition with batching for non-critical events.
ADR-020: Beacon data retention policy: raw events are kept for 30 days.
Beacon capacity planning document: projected to handle 1M events/day by t8.
ADR-021: Beacon uses a custom retry policy with exponential backoff (project-local).
ADR-012: All events must be processed exactly-once.
DEP-001: ADR-002 (JSON serialization) is deprecated and no longer valid.
Beacon scaling strategy: horizontal scaling with partition-aware consumers.
ADR-022: The main ingestion module is renamed to 'stream-ingest' (supersedes ADR-011).
ADR-015: At-least-once processing is acceptable for non-critical events (supersedes ADR-012).
Beacon alerting rules: page on >5% error rate, warn on >1% error rate.
ADR-023: Beacon current serialization format is Protobuf (confirmed).
Beacon serialization history: JSON (t0-t1), Protobuf (t1-present).
Beacon module naming history: ingest-core (t0-t3), event-gateway (t3-t6), stream-ingest (t6-present).
Beacon performance targets: 150,000 events per second by t12.
Beacon benchmark history: 85,000 eps at t3, 120,000 eps at t7.
DEP-002: ADR-003 (single partition) is deprecated and no longer valid.
Beacon retention comparison: S1=30 days, S2=90 days, S3=7 days.
ADR-025: Beacon will add encryption-at-rest for all stored events.
ADR-026: New data source configuration must comply with all current constraints.
Beacon encryption options: AES-256, ChaCha20, RSA-4096.
Beacon epoch summary: Foundation (t0-4), Growth (t5-9), Maturity (t10-14).
ADR-001: Marisol will use site-based partitioning for all clinical data.
ADR-002: The main pipeline module is named 'data-flow'.
CON-001: All patient data must be encrypted in transit (HIPAA).
ADR-003: Marisol will add HIPAA compliance requirements.
ADR-004: Marisol will use protocol-based partitioning (supersedes ADR-001).
Marisol monitoring uses Datadog with custom dashboards.
ADR-005: Marisol rejects the proposal to revert to site-based partitioning.
ADR-006: Marisol will use a single database connection pool.
Marisol testing strategy includes unit tests and integration tests.
ADR-007: Marisol will add a new API endpoint for data access.
ADR-008: Marisol will use multiple connection pools (supersedes ADR-006).
Marisol performance target is 50,000 queries per second.
ADR-009: The main pipeline module is renamed to 'trial-pipeline' (supersedes ADR-002).
ADR-010: Marisol data retention policy: patient data kept for 90 days.
ADR-011: Marisol will use a single connection pool with increased size.
Marisol benchmark at t5: 45,000 queries per second sustained.
Marisol scaling strategy: vertical scaling with read replicas.
ADR-030: All data exports must be approved by a Principal Investigator.
Marisol compliance: HIPAA, GDPR, 21 CFR Part 11.
ADR-031: Automated exports are allowed for de-identified data (supersedes ADR-030).
Marisol export procedures: manual review required for all exports.
ADR-013: The main pipeline module is renamed to 'clinical-ingest' (supersedes ADR-009).
ADR-014: Marisol partitioning strategy is protocol-based as of t9.
Marisol partitioning history: site-based (t0-t1), protocol-based (t1-present).
Marisol module naming history: data-flow (t0-t4), trial-pipeline (t4-t8), clinical-ingest (t8-present).
Marisol performance targets: 75,000 queries per second by t14.
Marisol benchmark history: 45,000 qps at t5, 60,000 qps at t9.
ADR-015: Marisol will add GDPR compliance requirements for EU clinical sites.
ADR-016: EU clinical site configuration must comply with all current constraints.
Marisol GDPR options: data minimization, right to erasure, consent management.
ADR-001: Harbor will use Markdown as the target format for all documentation.
ADR-002: Harbor will use manual migration for all documents.
ADR-003: The main migration module is named 'doc-migrate'.
CON-001: All migrated documents must preserve original URLs.
ADR-004: Harbor will add cross-reference validation for all migrated documents.
ADR-005: Harbor will use automated migration (supersedes ADR-002).
Harbor monitoring tracks migration progress and error rates.
ADR-006: Harbor rejects the proposal to revert to manual migration.
ADR-007: Harbor will use regex-based link rewriting.
Harbor testing strategy includes link validation and content comparison.
ADR-008: Harbor will use AST-based link rewriting (supersedes ADR-007).
ADR-009: Harbor will add a new document type with different URL patterns.
ADR-010: The main migration module is renamed to 'content-shift' (supersedes ADR-003).
ADR-005: Harbor documentation retention: 7 days for drafts.
Harbor performance target: 1,000 documents migrated per hour.
ADR-011: Harbor will use regex with better patterns for link rewriting.
DEP-001: ADR-002 (manual migration) is deprecated and no longer valid.
Harbor scaling strategy: parallel migration workers.
ADR-050: All documents must be reviewed by a technical writer.
ADR-051: Auto-migrated documents skip review if confidence > 95% (supersedes ADR-050).
Harbor confidence thresholds: 90% for drafts, 95% for final, 99% for published.
ADR-012: Harbor migration approach is automated as of t8.
Harbor migration history: manual (t0-t1), automated (t1-present).
ADR-013: The main migration module is renamed to 'doc-transform' (supersedes ADR-010).
DEP-002: ADR-007 (regex link rewriting) is deprecated and no longer valid.
Harbor module naming history: doc-migrate (t0-t4), content-shift (t4-t9), doc-transform (t9-present).
Harbor epoch summary: Foundation (t0-4), Growth (t5-9), Maturity (t10-14).
